notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.46 and later. Returns an object with optional integer cache_id; omitted fields remain absent. The source describes an eight-digit random cache version ID.
The client preserves integer values without string normalization or local eight-digit range checks. It does not generate the ID or promise uniqueness, monotonicity or security properties.

When an application updates a resource, explicitly call update() and append the returned cache_id to the resource URL query string as described by read(). The client does not fetch resources or change URLs. This browser cache version is separate from account NGINX cache management.
